verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs say local runs never leave the machine and that it keeps data private, and its API is served from localhost:11434. Community hands-on reports, including local benchmarks via 'ollama run', corroborate fully on-device inference; cloud models are an optional separate mode. missing for 10: independent verification that no telemetry or network traffic leaves the device during local inference, and in-depth first-party documentation of offline/air-gapped operation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Ollama lets you use open models with your coding agents so you can spend less while keeping your data private.
Ollama is definitely the easiest way to run LLMs locally
User benchmark on M4 Pro 48GB: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
